Cc: payments_ops@openstream-pay.com
Date: 2026-09-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New vendor: routing info & remittance layout request

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the onboarding intro. We're ready to share routing and remittance details to complete enrollment for OpenStream so Redwood can receive payouts via ACH/wire. Attached is our standard routing form (OpenStream_Routing_Form.pdf).

A couple of asks to make sure we align with your payops:
- Can you confirm Redwood's preferred remittance layout (CSV vs. flat text) and required fields so our payouts include PO and invoice mapping?
- Do you require a W-9 or any other tax form in advance of activation? If yes, we'll attach.
- We'll initiate a micro-test debit to validate ACH — is there a preferred test amount or reference string?

Planned attachments: routing form + remit_sample.csv (sample remittance layout).

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Cho
Head of Settlement Operations
OpenStream Payments
daniel.cho@openstream-pay.com
attachments: OpenStream_Routing_Form.pdf, remit_sample.csv
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@openstream-pay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-21T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor: routing info & remittance layout request

Daniel —

Thanks for sending the routing form. We've started intake on our side. Quick notes / next steps from Redwood finance: 

1) Required documents to finalize enrollment:
   - Completed routing form (your file looks fine but please include ACH account number + routing number on page 2)
   - Completed Vendor Onboarding Form (attached: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx) — includes invoice remit preferences and tax attestations
   - W-9 (if US entity) or equivalent tax doc for non-US vendors

2) Micro-test debit: our platform prefers vendors to accept a micro-debit; typical amounts we accept are random cents between $0.05–$0.99. Please use a clear reference string: OS-TEST-<vendor-id>. We'll confirm once it posts.

3) Remittance layout: we consume CSV with these headers as a minimum: invoice_id, po_number, gross_amount, remit_reference, invoice_date, currency. If you can add an additional column 'buyer_account' (Redwood account id) that helps auto-apply. I've linked a sample template in the onboarding sheet and attached PO-mapping-instructions.pdf for mapping rules.

4) PO process: finance will create a PO once the vendor is validated and the first invoice is expected. Our initial PO cadence is Net 30 unless otherwise negotiated.

Please return the completed onboarding xlsx and attach your W-9 and preferred remit_sample.csv if you have different column names. We'll kick off micro-test validation as soon as we receive those.

Marissa — please own the PO creation once validation is complete. Marcus — FYI on mapping rules in case we need to adjust ingest.

Cheers,
Priya Natarajan
Sr. Manager, Vendor Payments & Onboarding
Redwood Inference
attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx, PO-mapping-instructions.pdf

Priya —

Thanks, attached is our completed routing CSV (completed_routing.csv) and the populated remit sample (remit_sample.csv). We included the W-9 as well in the secure portal; I'll forward once I have the export.

We initiated the micro-test debit this morning:
- Amount: $0.32 USD
- Reference: OS-TEST-OSPAY-920316
- Bank trace: TX-OS-920316

Please confirm receipt when it lands. For remittance formatting, our team will emit a CSV that matches your required headers (we added buyer_account as requested). Sample row in remit_sample.csv:
"invoice_id,po_number,gross_amount,remit_reference,invoice_date,currency,buyer_account"
"INV-1137,PO-8472,12500.00,Payment for Aug usage,2026-08-31,USD,RDWD-3001"

Let me know if that sample looks good. We aim to be live for weekly payouts starting next month.

Daniel —

Confirmed: the micro-test debit of $0.32 has posted and matched the trace TX-OS-920316. That validates the ACH routing. Thanks for the quick turnaround and for adding buyer_account to the CSV.

We're all set to finalize enrollment. Summary & next steps: 
- Vendor status: Active (payment channel verified)
- PO: our finance team will issue PO-8472 to cover the initial contract period; Marissa will create the PO in Coupa and set payment terms Net 30.
- Remittance mapping: Redwood will accept the CSV you proposed. Please ensure the CSV includes invoice_id and po_number exactly as in the sample — our ingestion is case-sensitive for the column headers.
- First pay run: scheduled for 2026-10-07 (weekly cadence thereafter).

I've attached the final Vendor_Enrollment_Ack.pdf for your records and PO-mapping-instructions.pdf that Marissa will use to reconcile incoming remits. If you want a test remittance before the first live run, respond with TEST-RUN in your next message; we'll generate a small test payout into your account and send a remittance file for validation.

Thanks — welcome aboard.

Priya Natarajan
Sr. Manager, Vendor Payments & Onboarding
Redwood Inference
